basic_info.description: Great interest rates for SFH! Come view for yourself; used as true 2 bedroom, 2 bath house on 2 levels. Well-maintained, centrally-situated, walk to 24th St. Quiet, spacious, bright and private. Open floorplan, great for entertaining, formal entry, many closets and storage. Lower rooms with permits (staged as huge bedroom and office); full bath and laundry. Shared outdoor space; 1-car garage. Featured by The San Francisco Chronicle.
